title: WeeklyProjection
description: One player's next game as a distribution, from `weekly-startsit-v1` (ADR-096): seven quantiles of fantasy points in the row's scoring preset, GIVEN THAT HE PLAYS, for the game in `target_week`. A decision-layer model: it reads the rest-of-season snapshot's point-in-time features plus the game's sportsbook environment and the opponent's allowed points, and no intrinsic model reads it. The injury block is the league's official report printed beside the projection; the model never reads it. One record per player and scoring preset; league size changes nothing here, only the startable threshold the page compares against (published in `ros_build_metadata.weekly`).

through_week.description: The snapshot cutoff: weeks 1..through_week are the only in-season evidence.

target_week.description: The week being projected: always through_week + 1.

game_state.description: `upcoming`: the game had not kicked off when the build ran. `kicked_off`: it had (a Thursday game read on Friday) and the projection is kept for the record, not for a decision. `bye`: his team has no game in target_week; `game`, `quantiles`, `drivers` and `opponent` are null.

total_line.description: Sportsbook game total, from nflverse's schedule. A MODEL INPUT for this model (ADR-096), and for no other.

team_margin.description: The spread from this team's side: positive means favoured by that many.

team_points.description: (total + margin) / 2: the sportsbook's implied score for his team.

quantiles.description: Fantasy points in this preset, given an appearance. Monotone by construction; `quantile_distribution_v1` (in the build metadata) says how a page turns them into a distribution.

drivers.description: An additive account of q50: the median booster's expected value (`baseline`), grouped TreeSHAP contributions per feature family, the conformal shift (`calibration`) and whatever the monotone repair and rounding moved (`rearrangement`). The ten numbers sum to q50.

opponent.description: Fantasy points the opposing defence has allowed to this position per game through the cutoff, shrunk toward the league rate by four games (`weekly_game_context_v1`). `rank` 1 is the most generous defence.

injury.description: The league's official report for target_week as nflverse publishes it, or null when he is not on it. Printed beside the projection; never read by the model.
